X509Provider

Description:
X.509 Provider interface supporting two internal storage types: volatile (or
session) and persistent.
BuildDn
Create completed X.500 Distinguished
Name structure from the provided string
representation.
CheckCertStatus
Check certificate status by directly provided
OCSP response.
CheckCertStatusOnline
Check certificate status via On-line
Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP).
